a2-unit-15.15.1 Takeout:
Tom: Hey, do you want to get takeout tonight? I don't feel like cooking.
Lucy: Sure. Look, this menu came in the mail today. It's from the new burger place on our street.
Tom: Oh, I saw that place. What's on the menu?
Lucy: Well, it's a bit strange. I don't know where to begin. First, there's no meat in any of the burgers.
Tom: Really? What's in them?
Lucy: There's a bean burger and a nut burger.
Tom: That sounds OK.
Lucy: Wait, I haven't finished. Second, the buns are made with cricket flour.
Tom: Cricket flour? Like the insect? Seriously?
Lucy: Seriously. It says here it has a lot of protein. You can get normal buns too, though. Then, there are no potato fries.
Tom: No fries?
Lucy: Well, there are fries, but they're made from sweet potatoes from North Carolina.
Tom: That's cool. North Carolina grows more sweet potatoes than any other state. Can I get a milkshake, at least?
Lucy: That's the last strange thing on the menu. You can get a shake, but it's made with oat milk.
Tom: Honestly, I think it sounds great. All the other places around here are the same, and I'm bored with their food. At last, something different!
Lucy: I'm not sure.
Tom: Oh, come on. Remember the acai bowl in Miami? At first, you didn't want to try it, but then you tasted mine and you ate the whole thing!
Lucy: You're right. OK, let's try it.
Tom: Great. And look, they deliver, and all their bags are made of recycled paper. No plastic at all!
Lucy: Perfect. I'll have the bean burger and the sweet potato fries.
Tom: And I'll have the nut burger with a chocolate shake. I'll order online.
